name: @vulog/bo-widget-sdk
description: Framework-agnostic client for widgets embedded in the Vulog back office.
author: Vulog

scripts.check:package: publint --strict && attw --pack . --profile esm-only && node --input-type=module -e "const m = await import('@vulog/bo-widget-sdk'); const s = await import('@vulog/bo-widget-sdk/manifest'); if (typeof m.connect !== 'function' || typeof s.widgetManifestSchema?.safeParse !== 'function') throw new Error('@vulog/bo-widget-sdk: exports not resolved from dist');"
